en.headline: Linn says applications for new building repairs lists double or triple previous numbers
en.dek: The development secretary said about 150 consultants and 350 contractors have applied for pre-qualified lists under the new Building Maintenance Support and Services Council.
body: Secretary for Development Bernadette Linn said the government has received an encouraging response from consultants and contractors seeking inclusion on three pre-qualified lists for a new council that will offer full-cycle building repairs.

Speaking on a radio programme on Saturday, Linn said about 150 applications had come from inspection and supervision consultants and about 350 from contractors. She said the numbers were two to three times those on the previous Urban Renewal Authority Smart Tender list, which has been taken down.

The non-statutory Building Maintenance Support and Services Council is to be established by the end of the year and will gradually take over the authority’s building-upkeep subsidy schemes. Linn described the increase as a vote of confidence in the future system.

The council will prioritise around 1,800 maintenance projects already in the Smart Tender system, focusing first on the roughly 600 that have not yet undergone building inspections. The reforms follow recommendations from the independent committee report on the Wang Fuk Court fire in Tai Po.

zh.headline: 甯漢豪：新維修名單申請量為以往兩至三倍
zh.dek: 發展局局長指約有150名顧問及350名承建商申請加入新樓宇維修支援及服務委員會的預審名單。
body: 發展局局長甯漢豪表示，政府收到顧問及承建商申請加入新委員會三個預審名單的反應令人鼓舞，該委員會將提供全周期樓宇維修服務。
她周六在電台節目中說，檢查及監督顧問約有150宗申請，承建商約350宗。與市建局已下架的「智方便」預審名單相比，數字是以往的兩至三倍。
非法定的樓宇維修支援及服務委員會將於年底成立，並逐步接管市建局的樓宇維修資助計劃。甯漢豪形容這是業界對未來制度投下信心一票。
委員會將優先處理已在「智方便」系統內約1800個維修項目，首先集中約600個尚未進行樓宇檢驗的項目。有關改革是因應大埔宏福苑火災獨立委員會報告的建議。
